source.author: verg
source.text: Punica regna vides, Tyrios et Agenoris urbem; sed fines Libyci, genus intractabile bello.
source.text_original: Punica regna vides, Tyrios et Agenoris urbem; / sed fines Libyci, genus intractabile bello.
source.text_english: You see the Punic kingdom, the Tyrians, and the city of Agenor; but these are Libyan borders, a race unyielding in war.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Praetermitto Carthaginis conditores Tyrios, et Agenoris urbem; praetereo Thebas Liberi, quas in Africa condidit: quae civitas nunc Thebestis dicitur.
reuse.text_original: Praetermitto Carthaginis conditores Tyrios, et Agenoris urbem; praetereo Thebas Liberi, quas in Africa condidit: quae civitas nunc Thebestis dicitur.
reuse.text_english: I pass over the Tyrians, founders of Carthage, and the city of Agenor; I pass over Thebes of Liber, which he founded in Africa: this city is now called Thebestis.
